kaps_punt: Verskillende ekostelsels: 'n ekostelsel is 'n gebied waar lewende en nie-lewende dinge afhanklik is van mekaar op verskillende maniere; daar is baie verskillende ekostelsels, soos riviere, berge, see, rotsagtige kus, damme, vleilande, grasvelde, woude en woestyne, wat verskillende soorte lewende dinge onderhou. Lewende en nie-lewende dinge in ekostelsels: in 'n ekostelsel is daar sekere verhoudings tussen lewende dinge (plante, diere/mense, mikro-organismes), en nie-lewende dinge (lug, water, sonlig, grond) in 'n bepaalde gebied *. [Voetnoot *: Gesonde ekostelsels is afhanklik van voldoende biodiversiteit van plante, diere en hul habitatte.]

items.bewering: Paddas skuil tussen die riete en vang die insekte wat daar rondvlieg.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Frog': adult frogs 'generally have a carnivorous diet consisting of small invertebrates, especially insects'.

items.bewering: Die riete self het modder, water en sonlig nodig om te groei.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Phragmites australis' (wetland grass forming reed beds); Wikipedia 'Soil' (soil gives plants support, water, nutrients); Wikipedia 'Photosynthesis' (light energy). The list is not presented as exhaustive, so omitting air/CO2 here is not a false claim; the lesson names the air gas later.

items.bewering: Die son en die lug het egter nie die paddas of die riete nodig nie.
items.bron: True as stated: non-living things have no needs, and the sun and a pond's air do not depend on these particular frogs and reeds. Wikipedia 'Ecosystem' and 'Photosynthesis' note that living things do alter the atmosphere (photosynthesis maintains atmospheric oxygen); the lesson says exactly that in 'Lewende dinge verander die nie-lewende dele', so the two blocks do not conflict.

items.bewering: 'n Habitat is net die plek waar een plant of dier lewe. 'n Ekostelsel is die hele gebied met al daardie plekke daarin.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Habitat': 'the natural environment of an organism, the type of place in which it is natural for it to live and grow'; Wikipedia 'Ecosystem': organisms in interaction with their environment over an area.

items.bewering: Daar is baie verskillende ekostelsels op aarde. Party is nat en ander is baie droog. Elkeen het daarom sy eie soorte plante en diere wat daar goed lewe.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Ecosystem'; Wikipedia 'Wetland' and 'Gemsbok' (desert) illustrate the wet/dry range; CAPS NST Gr 4-6 (DBE) Gr 6 Term 1 content.

items.bewering: Rivier: vars water wat stroomaf vloei. Visse soos die geelvis swem daarin.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Labeobarbus': freshwater cyprinids widely distributed in southern Africa, incl. largemouth and smallmouth yellowfish (L. kimberleyensis, L. aeneus).

items.bewering: Berg: hoë, steil hange met baie rotse. Klipspringers spring daar van rots tot rots.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Klipspringer': 'inhabits places characterised by rocky terrain'; hooves enable it 'to deftly climb and jump over rocky surfaces'; name means 'rock leaper'.

items.bewering: See: 'n baie groot gebied soutwater. Dolfyne en haaie swem daarin.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Water' / general marine biology; dolphins and sharks are marine animals (common knowledge corroborated by any reference work; low risk).

items.bewering: Rotsagtige kus: rotse waaroor die golwe breek. Klipmossels sit styf aan die rotse vas.
items.bron: Afrikaans 'klipmossel' could not be pinned to one animal group from available sources, but the claim holds for both candidates: Wikipedia 'Mussel' (marine mussels attach to a firm substrate with byssal threads, intertidal) and Wikipedia 'Limpet' ('cling extremely firmly to the surfaces on which they live'). Afrikaans Wikipedia 'Mossel': 'aan die bodem geanker' by bissusdrade.

items.bewering: Dam: water wat stil in 'n kom of agter 'n wal staan. Baie paddas lê hulle eiers daarin.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Frog': 'Frogs typically spawn their eggs in bodies of water.' 'Baie' (not 'alle') is correctly scoped.

items.bewering: Vleiland: grond wat lank nat is of onder vlak water lê. Riete groei daar dig op mekaar.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Wetland': water covers the soil or is at/near the surface for varying periods; Wikipedia 'Phragmites australis': 'commonly forms extensive stands (known as reed beds)'. Read as a typical example, like the animal in every other item.

items.bewering: Grasveld: oop land met baie gras en min of geen bome. Blesbokke wei daar.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Grassland' (vegetation dominated by grasses); Wikipedia 'Blesbok': 'preferred habitat is open grassland'; Animal Diversity Web (Univ. of Michigan) 'Damaliscus pygargus': 'they graze on grasses', 'diurnal grazers'.

items.bewering: Woud: hoë bome wat naby mekaar groei, met skaduwee onder hulle. Die Knysnaloerie lewe hoog in die bome.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Knysna turaco': inhabits mature evergreen forests of South Africa and Eswatini; 'often inconspicuous in the treetops', 'hopping along branches'.

items.bewering: Woestyn: 'n plek waar baie min reën val, met sand of klippe. Die gemsbok kan lank sonder drinkwater klaarkom.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Gemsbok': 'mainly desert-dwelling and do not depend on drinking water'; tsamma melons and roots 'can provide all the water required'.

items.bewering: Die lewende dele van 'n ekostelsel is die plante, die diere en die mikro-organismes. Mense is ook diere, en ons is deel van die ekostelsels waar ons woon.
items.bron: CAPS NST Gr 4-6 (DBE), Gr 6 Term 1 (plants, animals/humans, micro-organisms); Wikipedia 'Ecosystem'. Humans are biologically animals.

items.bewering: Mikro-organismes is so klein dat jy hulle net deur 'n mikroskoop kan sien. Hulle lewe in die grond, in die water en selfs op jou vel.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Microorganism': 'an organism of microscopic size'; found in water, soil, air and 'as the microbiome of an organism'.

items.bewering: Die meeste van hierdie klein lewende dinge maak niemand siek nie.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Pathogen': 'the vast majority are either harmless or beneficial ... a small percentage are pathogenic'.

items.bewering: Die lug hou die suurstof wat mense, diere en plante vir asemhaling gebruik. Plante neem ook 'n ander gas uit die lug om hulle kos te maak.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Cellular respiration' (aerobic respiration requires oxygen; plants respire); Wikipedia 'Photosynthesis' (plants take CO2 from the atmosphere to make carbohydrates); CAPS Gr 5 Term 1 'Food and feeding'.

items.bewering: Elke plant en dier het water nodig, en baie van hulle lewe self daarin.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Water': 'vital for all known forms of life'.

items.bewering: Sonlig gee plante die energie om kos te maak en verwarm die land en die water.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Photosynthesis': 'captures energy from sunlight to convert carbon dioxide into carbohydrates'.

items.bewering: Die grond hou plante se wortels vas en gee hulle water en voedingstowwe. Erdwurms en miere maak ook hulle huise in die grond.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Soil': 'Soils offer plants physical support, air, water, temperature moderation, nutrients'; earthworms and ants listed among soil dwellers.

items.bewering: Groen plante gee byvoorbeeld suurstof aan die lug af wanneer hulle kos maak. Baie diere asem daardie suurstof dan weer in.
items.blok: Lewende dinge verander die nie-lewende dele
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Photosynthesis': releases oxygen; 'the main source of oxygen in the Earth's atmosphere'; CAPS Gr 5 Term 1: plants 'release oxygen into the air'.

items.bewering: In graad 5 het jy geleer wat biodiversiteit is.
items.bron: CAPS NST Gr 4-6 (DBE, English edition, printed p. 31), Gr 5 Term 1 'Plants and animals on Earth', note *: 'Plants and animals, and their habitats make up the total biodiversity of the Earth.'

items.bewering: 'n Gesonde ekostelsel het genoeg daarvan nodig. Baie soorte plante gee aan die diere baie soorte kos en skuiling.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 6 footnote (healthy ecosystems depend on sufficient biodiversity); Wikipedia 'Grassland': wild-plant diversity is associated with 'a rich invertebrate fauna' and grassland-specialist birds.

items.bewering: Dink aan 'n grasveld wat sy veldblomme en baie van sy grassoorte verloor. Party insekte en voëls kry dan nie meer genoeg kos nie, en hulle kan ook verdwyn. Die diere wat daardie insekte en voëls eet, kry dan swaar. Die plekke waar die plante en diere lewe, moet ook heel bly.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Pollinator decline': declines driven partly by 'lack of flowers', with effects reaching insectivorous birds; Wikipedia 'Grassland': forb species most prone to loss; loss of plant diversity threatens grassland invertebrates and specialist birds. The chain is hedged ('party', 'kan') and sound.

items.bewering: ekostelsel: 'n Gebied waar lewende dinge van mekaar en van die nie-lewende dinge om hulle afhang.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Ecosystem': 'a system formed by organisms in interaction with their environment'; consistent with the CAPS Gr 6 definition.

items.bewering: habitat: Die plek waar 'n plant of 'n dier lewe.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Habitat': 'the natural environment of an organism, the type of place in which it is natural for it to live and grow'.

items.bewering: vleiland: Land wat lank nat is of onder vlak water lê, met plante wat in nat grond groei, soos riete.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Wetland': saturated or shallow-water land supporting 'vegetation typically adapted for life in saturated soil conditions'; Wikipedia 'Phragmites australis' (wetland grass).

items.bewering: mikro-organisme: 'n Lewende ding wat so klein is dat 'n mens dit net deur 'n mikroskoop kan sien.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Microorganism': 'an organism of microscopic size'.

items.bewering: suurstof: 'n Gas wat plante afgee wanneer hulle kos maak, en wat mense, diere en plante vir asemhaling gebruik.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Photosynthesis' (releases oxygen); Wikipedia 'Cellular respiration' (aerobic respiration requires O2; plants respire).

items.bewering: asemhaling: Om suurstof te gebruik om energie uit jou kos te kry.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Cellular respiration': oxidising biological fuels to produce ATP; 'Aerobic respiration requires oxygen'. The entry describes respiration rather than breathing, which is what makes 'plante ... vir asemhaling' elsewhere in the lesson correct. Anaerobic respiration is not addressed; not a false claim at this level.

items.bewering: voedingstof: 'n Stof wat 'n lewende ding nodig het om te groei en gesond te bly. Party voedingstowwe in kos gee ook energie.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Soil' (nutrients for plant growth); 'Party' correctly limits the energy claim (mineral nutrients from soil give no energy; carbohydrates and fats in food do).

items.bewering: biodiversiteit: Hoeveel verskillende soorte lewende dinge daar in 'n plek of op die hele Aarde is.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Biodiversity': 'the variability of life on Earth', incl. species diversity ('the number and variety of different species'). The entry gives the species level only, a sound simplification.

opsomming: Alle 33 bewerings is teen bronne nagegaan en bevestig (geen eli10-analogie in die les nie; die twee kwantifiseerders 'die meeste' en 'elke' klop); let wel net dat 'klipmossel' nie tot een diergroep vasgepen kon word nie, maar die bewering geld vir sowel mossels as klipslakke.
